verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਕਰੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਵਾਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise narapat bahu banitaa bivaeh karai jaa kai janamat sut vaahee gireh raaj hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a king marries many young maids, but she who produces him a son has the kingdom in her home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ੳਦਧਿ ਮਧਿ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਮੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਲੈ ਜੋਈ ਪਾਰ ਪਹੰੁਚੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise udhadh madh chahoo(n) or mai bohith chalai joiee paar paha(n)uchai pooran sarab kaaj hai ||

en.bdb: Just as ships sail in the ocean from all directions, but the ship that reaches its destination safely and on time, its travellers are benefited the most.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਨਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਜੁ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khaan khanat ana(n)t khanavaaraa khojee heeraa haath chaRai jaa kai taa kai baaj baaj hai ||

en.bdb: As the miners dig the mines and one who is able to dig out or locate a diamond indulges in merry-making and festivities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਅਉ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਿ ਕਟਾਛਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੧॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh navatan aau puraatan jin par kaTaachh kirapaa taa kai chhab chhaaj hai ||371||

en.bdb: So are many old and new Sikhs of the True Guru. But those who are blessed with His clemency and look of grace, become noble, beautiful, wise and respectable through meditation of Naam. (371)
